 Search "All of Us Are Dead" Season 2: Cheong-san’s Fate Confirmed and Netflix Release Date Updated!
 Disha Paul 45 minutes ago 4 min read All of Us Are Dead season 2: IS CHEONG-SAN ALIVE? (Netflix) After years of waiting, All of Us Are Dead  fans finally have a major reason to get excited about Season 2 . Yoon Chan-young has confirmed that Lee Cheong-san is alive, answering one of the biggest questions left behind by the first season's devastating finale. 
 The  reveal came during Netflix Korea's 10th-anniversary celebration in Seoul on October 24, 2026 . But while the returning cast gave fans something to celebrate, the event did not deliver the Season 2 teaser or release date many had hoped for. So, when can viewers expect the next chapter of Netflix's zombie thriller? 
 All of Us Are Dead Season 2: What Did Netflix Reveal ? 
 The highlight of the anniversary showcase was Yoon Chan-young's return to the stage as Cheong-san. Addressing fans who believed his character had died in Season 1, the actor confirmed that Cheong-san is still alive. 
 Park Ji-hu , who plays Nam On-jo, reacted to the  reveal by expressing relief that Cheong-san would return after leaving so many unanswered questions. Their reunion is particularly meaningful for viewers who have spent years wondering what happened after Cheong-san sacrificed himself during the Hyosan outbreak. 
 However, fans should not expect the survival  reveal to explain everything just yet. Netflix has not disclosed exactly how Cheong-san escaped his apparent death, whether he has become a half-zombie, or what his return will mean for On-jo and the other survivors. 
 When Will All of Us Are Dead Season 2 Be Released? 
 Netflix has not announced an official release date for All of Us Are Dead  Season 2.  The series was presented as an upcoming title at the anniversary event, but no confirmed premiere day or month was revealed. 
 A 2027 release looks more plausible than a 2026 premiere. Season 2 began production in July 2025, and filming reportedly wrapped in February 2026. The series also involves extensive zombie action and visual effects, which require time to complete during post-production. 
 That makes an early-2027 release a reasonable possibility, but it remains an expectation rather than confirmed news. Fans should be cautious about social media posts claiming a specific month until Netflix announces it officially. 
 When Can We Expect the First Teaser or Trailer? 
 Unfortunately, the anniversary event did not bring the first Season 2 teaser or full trailer. The cast's appearance and Cheong-san's survival confirmation generated excitement, but Netflix has yet to announce a date for new footage. 
 A short teaser could arrive before the full trailer, potentially alongside a release-window announcement. If Netflix is targeting a 2027 premiere, a promotional campaign could begin in the months leading up to its release. However, that is only a possibility, not a confirmed schedule. 
 All of Us Are Dead 2 Confirmed Cast (Netflix) For now, fans should keep an eye on Netflix's official channels rather than relying on fan-made trailers or videos that use Season 1 footage. 
 Who Is Returning for Season 2? 
 The four leading survivors are returning: Park Ji-hu as Nam On-jo, Yoon Chan-young as Lee Cheong-san, Cho Yi-hyun as Choi Nam-ra, and Lomon as Lee Su-hyeok. 
 Season 2 will also introduce new faces, including Lee Min-jae , Kim Si-eun , Roh Jae-won , and Yoon Ga-i . The story moves beyond Hyosan High School, with On-jo now studying at university in Seoul before a new outbreak forces her into another fight for survival. 
 Director Lee JQ and Kim Nam-su are returning, with Chun Sung-il writing the new season. The expanded setting and cast suggest that the sequel will explore a larger outbreak rather than simply repeat the original school's fight for survival. 
 What Does Cheong-san's Return Mean for Season 2? 
 Yoon Chan-young as Lee Cheong-san in All of Us Are Dead (Netflix) Cheong-san's survival confirmation could change the emotional direction of the sequel. His relationship with On-jo was one of Season 1's most heartbreaking storylines, and viewers will naturally want to know whether the two can reunite after everything they endured. 
 But the bigger question is what happened to him after the explosion. Did he survive as a human, or did the virus change him? And how will his return affect the other survivors, especially Nam-ra, who was already struggling with her half-zombie identity? 
 Those answers remain under wraps. For now, the most exciting thing is that Cheong-san's story is not over. 
 The Wait Is Not Over Yet 
 All of Us Are Dead  Season 2 has finally given fans a meaningful update, but the wait for an actual trailer and release date continues. Cheong-san's return is a major development, and the move to Seoul promises a wider and potentially more dangerous outbreak. 
 Until Netflix shares more, the best we can do is keep expectations realistic and wait for official footage. After such a long gap, fans deserve more than rumours, and hopefully the next update will bring a first look at the survivors' new fight. 
 Are you excited that Cheong-san is alive? And what do you want to see first: the Season 2 teaser, a release date, or a reunion between Cheong-san and On-jo?
